name: Crystal Ball of Telepathy
summary: A crystal orb that casts Scrying and lets you speak telepathically through its sensor.

stats.effect: While touching this crystal orb, you can cast *Scrying* (save DC 17) with it. In addition, you can communicate telepathically with creatures you can see within 30 feet of the spell's sensor. You can also cast *{ref:spell/suggestion}* (save DC 17) through the sensor on one of those creatures. You don't need to concentrate on this *{ref:spell/suggestion}* to maintain it during its duration, but it ends if *Scrying* ends. You can't cast *{ref:spell/suggestion}* in this way again until the next dawn.
